lane: S81-CTRL 10-17 -> S81-DIE (bind_table_p4i.json masters.dsfd_ctrl_rg2 is null today)

dsfd_ctrl_rg2.view: s81ctrl_rg2 (ref_tile kit physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg2; not routed yet)

clk2.net: the PHY's clock (same net as u_phy_hbm.clk)
clk2.note: HBM domain; async to clk through ot_s81ph_afifo

rq.i.layout: PC p at [341p +: 341] = {wdata 256, wstrb 32, tag 17, len 4, addr 30, we, v}

rd.o.layout: PC p at [280p +: 280] = {wd, rk, rv, beat 4, tag 17, data 256}; [561:560] = {fault, live}

phy_face.note: replaces the plan's 2 x 695-b DFI lanes (no RTL port maps to them): abutted named connections to the one PHY instance, region k = PCs 2k, 2k+1
phy_face.phy_unused: PHY W port (w_v/w_addr/w_len/w_tag/wr_rdy inputs) is the QE weight region, unused on S81 (weights in the ROM field): mode-unused pads, as dsfd_ctrl tied them; k_oor/w_oor/refreshes/w_reads outputs -> the S81 fault tree / open

dsfd_ctrl_rg2.consumer_contract: dsdv_svc_rs (S81U-1) issues rq words on compiler slots within DQ=8 outstanding per PC (rk returns one per request the PHY took; overflow is dropped + sticky fault rd[561]); rd has no ready: every rv word must be taken the cycle it arrives (landing buffer in the svc slice, one ready check per buffer block).
